verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships AI features (an AI code reviewer, AI-powered pipeline workflows, Rovo in terminal/IDE), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows those features can connect to external MCP servers or use their tools. The official Atlassian MCP server (probe-4) is the opposite role: it exposes Atlassian to other agents and does not let Bitbucket consume MCP tools, so it is not credited here.
